correctness.rationale: For bidirected G=K1 join disjoint union of clique C_i, each peripheral vertex has outdegree s_i and the hub has sum s_i. Every majority-stable set contains at most b_i=floor(s_i/2)+1 vertices from hub∪C_i: without hub select <=b_i, with hub select <=a_i=floor(s_i/2). Summed fractional cover inequalities yield W≥max_i(s_i+1)/b_i. For the reverse inequality, mix H-sets consisting of hub plus independent uniform a_i-subsets with weight 1 and B-sets consisting of uniform b_i-subsets without hub with weight L−1. Every sample is majority-stable including hub constraint sum a_i≤(sum s_i)/2, and every peripheral vertex gets (L b_i−1)/s_i≥1 while hub gets 1. This proves exact all t,s_i including t=1,s_i=1. Independently checked rational values (1)->2, (2)->3/2, (3)->2, (2,4)->5/3, (2,2,2)->3/2 and the literal supplied verify.py definition; did not independently rerun uploaded SciPy LP census.
